a: ROW_NUMBER() assigns unique ranks within a partition ordered by a key.
RANK leaves gaps after ties; DENSE_RANK does not.
LAG/LEAD access previous/next row values without self-joins.
SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY t) computes a running total.
AVG(x) OVER (ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW).
NTILE(n) buckets rows into n roughly equal groups.
PARTITION BY resets window calculations per group.
FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE return boundary values in the window frame.
Some engines support QUALIFY to filter on window function results.
ROWS/RANGE define which neighboring rows are included in the frame.
